_comment: Kafka topics, the producer and the CDE streaming job (standard library json). Topics are created from CDE (the brokers' ports are closed from the laptop).
_live_window: When the live stream runs (UTC; 09:00-19:00 IST): the DAG mcc_live_stream starts the bronze stream and the live producer at start_utc on lakehouse.json scheduled_dates, and both stop themselves at stop_utc. A manual start (mcc_deploy_streaming.sh start|live) stops at the next stop_utc or guard_minutes before batch_utc, whichever comes first, and refuses to start within batch_minutes after batch_utc, so a live stream never overlaps the nightly batch's replay. The producer stops producer_lead_seconds before the stream, so its last events are ingested.
